## Checklist

- [ ] Base branch is `development` (or `main` for a release or hotfix PR).
- [ ] PR title follows Conventional Commits (`feat(scope): ...`).
- [ ] Tested on the Fire TV device or simulator.
- [ ] D-pad focus works on every new screen.
- [ ] README or `docs/` updated if setup or behavior changed.
- [ ] New friction found? Logged with the "Friction log" issue template.
